title: When the Blue Hour Burns
author: Yara Hartwell
blurb: Ada Hartwell, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
